templates.text: New task work available! Join our product boosting team and complete simple app tasks in sets of 40. Earn ${RATE} per day, paid to your wallet. Reply START to get your first task set.
Great progress! You finished this task set and earned ${AMT} in commissions. Deposit ${DEP} USDT to upgrade to VIP tasks and double your commission rate.
Your task account shows a negative balance of ${AMT} after a premium order. Top up ${DEP} in crypto within 24 hours to restore your account and keep earning.
Work from your phone rating products and liking posts for online stores. No experience needed, training is provided in our chat group. Message us to begin: {PHONE}
Congratulations, your reviewer level is now Gold. Withdraw your ${AMT} balance after completing one combined task set. A refundable security deposit of ${DEP} is required to activate combined tasks.
Your exchange account holding ${AMT} in USDT has been flagged for verification. Send a verification deposit of ${DEP} in crypto to confirm ownership and release your funds.
Withdrawal pending: a network unlock fee of ${FEE} must be paid before your ${AMT} balance can be released to your wallet. Pay here: {URL}
Final notice: your trading account will be closed in 48 hours. Pay the outstanding withdrawal tax of ${AMT} to unlock and withdraw your full balance today.
Good news, your mining earnings of ${AMT} are ready. Accounts under 90 days must add a refundable deposit of ${DEP} before the first withdrawal is unlocked.
Security alert: we froze your wallet after unusual activity. Verify your identity with a small deposit of ${DEP} and your ${AMT} will be unlocked immediately.
My love, I hate to ask but I am stuck at customs and they will not release me without a fee. Please send ${AMT} by gift card today so I can finally come home to you.
Darling, my leave was approved! I need ${AMT} for the plane ticket to come see you. Wire it to my friend who can book it for me, I will pay you back double.
Honey I am in the hospital after an accident on the rig and the doctors need ${AMT} before they will operate. Please, you are the only one I can turn to.
Sweetheart, remember the crypto trading my commander taught me? Send ${AMT} to my wallet and I will double it for our future together, I promise.
My dearest, the visa office needs the processing fee of ${AMT} paid by gift card PIN today or my application is cancelled. Do not let them keep us apart.
Grandma, it's me, please don't tell Mom and Dad. I was in a car accident and got arrested, I need ${AMT} for bail right now. A bondsman will call you with instructions.
This is attorney {NAME} calling about your grandson. He is in custody after an accident and needs ${AMT} wired today for bail and court fees. Please keep this confidential.
Grandpa, I am in the hospital in {STATE} and I lost my phone. The hospital needs ${AMT} before they treat me. Send gift cards and read the numbers to the nurse's aide who calls.
It's your granddaughter, I am stuck in {STATE} after my car broke down and the police are involved. A courier will come to your house to pick up ${AMT} in cash for my release.
Please don't hang up, Grandma. I know I sound different, my nose is broken from the crash. My lawyer needs ${AMT} by wire transfer before {DAY} or I stay in jail.

meta.purpose: Scam Shield v8 seed templates. gig_task + crypto_unlock are NEW TRAINING families in the task-scam space (v7's held-out exam showed task_job language does not transfer). romance + grandparent are NEW EXAM families: excluded from ALL v8 training and validation; the v8 held-out exam is generated from all their templates. Seeds come ONLY from US-government publications (FTC consumer alerts/articles and data spotlights, FBI IC3 PSAs and fbi.gov fraud pages, FCC consumer guides, FinCEN alerts) read 2026-11-18, or are faithful templates of the exact script mechanics those publications describe. Slot placeholders like {AMT}, {DEP}, {URL} are filled ONLY by deterministic code in augment_v4.py (fixed lists, fictional 555 numbers, code-generated lookalike URLs). No LLM wrote any seed text; no social-media posts were used as data.

crypto_unlock: FBI, 'Cryptocurrency Investment Fraud', fbi.gov - account frozen at withdrawal; arbitrary 'taxes'/'fees' demanded to unlock funds
FinCEN Alert on pig-butchering / crypto investment fraud (Sep 2023) - 'taxes, fees or penalties' demanded before withdrawal
FTC Consumer Advice, 'What To Know About Cryptocurrency and Scams', consumer.ftc.gov
gig_task: FTC Data Spotlight, 'Paying to Get Paid: Gamified Job Scams Drive Record Losses' (Dec 2024), ftc.gov
FTC Consumer Alert, 'How to spot and avoid task scams' (2025-08-14), consumer.ftc.gov
FBI, 'Cryptocurrency Investment Fraud' (Cryptocurrency Job Scams section), fbi.gov
grandparent: FTC Consumer Advice, 'Family emergency scams', consumer.ftc.gov
FCC Consumer Guide, ''Grandparent' Scams' - grandchild in trouble, secrecy ('don't tell Mom and Dad'), lawyer/bondsman handoff, wire/gift cards/courier cash
FBI IC3 PSA I-120324-PSA (2024-12-03), 'Criminals Use Generative Artificial Intelligence to Facilitate Financial Fraud' - impersonated close relative in a crisis demanding immediate money
romance: FTC Consumer Advice, 'What To Know About Romance Scams', consumer.ftc.gov - fake profiles; can never meet (military, oil rig, abroad); money for medical expenses, plane tickets, visas, customs/fees; crypto investing offers; payment by wire, gift-card PINs, payment apps, cryptocurrency

meta.split_rule: For the TRAINING families (gig_task, crypto_unlock): per family, template index 1 is validation-only and index 3 is test-only; all other templates are train (same rule as seeds_v4.json). For the EXAM families (romance, grandparent): NO template is train or validation; all templates generate exam rows only.
